_doc: Hand-curated combat styles, martial arts, and learned techniques (excluding Devil Fruit powers and Haki, which have their own pages). Sword styles, kicking arts, fishman karate, ninjutsu, etc.

styles.name: Santoryu (Three Sword Style)
styles.summary: Wields three swords — one in each hand and one in the mouth. Zoro's signature combat form.

styles.name: Nine Sword Style (Asura)
styles.summary: An Observation-Haki-fuelled illusion that gives Zoro the appearance of three heads and six arms wielding nine swords. First used vs Kaku.

styles.name: King of Hell (Kiki Kutsugi)
styles.origin: Wano — Zoro fully embraces Enma + Conqueror's Coating
styles.summary: Onigashima rooftop form — Zoro's strikes coat in Conqueror's Haki via Enma's drain. Cuts through Kaidou's hide.
key_attacks: Three Sword Style: Black Rope Dragon Twister

styles.name: Black Leg Style
styles.summary: All-kicks martial art — Sanji never uses his hands for combat to protect them as a chef's tools.

styles.name: Diable Jambe
styles.summary: Heat-up kick — spin-friction creates fire on the leg. Enhanced by Armament Haki post-timeskip.

styles.name: Ifrit Jambe
styles.japanese: イフリート・ジャンベ
styles.origin: Sanji, Wano — combines Diable Jambe with his awakened Vinsmoke Genome
styles.summary: Blue-flame kick — colder yet more destructive. Used vs Queen on Onigashima.

styles.name: Fishman Karate
styles.summary: Strikes the water itself. Underwater, a fishman's strength is multiplied — water-shotting can shatter stone from a distance.

styles.name: Fishman Jujutsu
styles.origin: Fishman Island — companion grappling form to Karate
styles.summary: Throws and joint-locks using the water as a medium. Can grab and redirect water itself.

styles.name: Rokushiki (Six Powers)
styles.summary: Superhuman martial techniques developed by the World Government. The six are Geppo, Tekkai, Soru, Shigan, Rankyaku, Kami-e — plus the secret seventh, Rokuogan.

styles.name: Electro
styles.summary: Inborn ability of the Mink Tribe — the body generates and discharges electric current. Can be channelled through weapons and limbs.

styles.name: Sulong
styles.summary: Under a full moon, Mink Tribe members transform into a hyper-evolved beast form — silver fur, vastly enhanced strength and speed. Considered Minks' true potential.

styles.name: Ramen Kenpo
styles.summary: Joke martial art that uses the user's ramen-noodle-like braided hair as projectiles and grapples.

styles.name: Tonkachi (Hammer Style)
styles.summary: Sword/punch style that channels Conqueror's-tier striking force through a sharpened cone of will.

styles.name: Octopus Pot Rosary
styles.summary: Six-sword style using all six octopus arms — Hatchan's signature.

styles.name: Iaido / Quick-Draw
styles.summary: Sword draw-and-cut as a single motion. Maximum damage on the opening strike.

styles.name: Kappa-ryū / Fishman Sword Style
styles.summary: Sword style developed by Kawamatsu while imprisoned in the Sea Prison. Combines fishman strength with samurai blade work.
